notes: Trigger cases only. Every skill in the claude/workflow group is installed for
every case, because a group is the unit people install -- so a case can fail by
the wrong sibling firing, not just by silence.
The should_not_trigger arm is mostly other members of this group. These skills
are adjacent by design (plan/execute/delegate, request/receive review), so the
queries that discriminate between them are the ones worth measuring. Obvious
non-matches would report a precision none of them has earned.
should_trigger: I've finished the feature. Get it reviewed before I merge.
Can you review the changes on this branch against the requirements?
Before this goes in, have someone check the implementation.
I want a code review on what I just wrote.
Dispatch a reviewer over this diff and report what it finds.
Check my work meets the spec before I open the PR.
Please review the code I've just implemented for this ticket.
Give this a proper review pass before merge.
should_not_trigger: The reviewer said my error handling is wrong. Should I just change it?
I got review feedback that seems technically incorrect. What now?
The feature is complete and tests pass. Merge or PR?
Write a plan for the next feature.
Run the linter over this file.
Keep fixing until CI is green.
Set up an isolated worktree for the review branch.
